turns.user: Daniel fell and the doctor says he fractured his hip, or possibly his tibia - they are not sure yet. It is a closed fracture from an accident at home. What would his accident cover pay?
turns.visible:
The Group Personal Accident Benefit Summary (page 8) pays the Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident as a percentage of Daniel's own sum insured (S$600,000 on the certificate) for each listed case: Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break) 100%; Hip 75%; Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture) 50%; Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine 30%; Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture) 20%.
Which of these cases is it: Hip or Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture)?

turns.user: The scan shows it is the tibia.
turns.visible:
If the Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident benefit applies to Daniel's case “Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee” (the row the document labels “Other Fracture”; these documents print no definition of which fractures that is), the conditional illustration is S$300,000: 50% of Daniel's sum insured of S$600,000 (Group Personal Accident), under the Group Personal Accident Benefit Summary; it is an illustration from the document's terms, not a payment or an insurer's decision.
You told me the scan shows it is the tibia.
The Group Personal Accident Benefit Summary says the benefit applies to bodily injury resulting from an accident and a fracture of a nature listed in its schedule.

E. Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which results in a Simple Fracture or Other Fracture of the nature
mentioned in the table below, we will pay the relevant amount specified in the table:-
Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident
Compensation
Schedule
(% of Sum Insured)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%

Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture)	20%
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
F.	Disappearance
If an Insured Person:
(i)	disappears as a result of the sinking or wrecking of the ship, aeroplane or vehicle in which he was travelling at the time of the Accident; and
(ii)	his body is not found within l year from the date of his disappearance; and
(iii) there is sufficient evidence leading to the conclusion that the Insured Person sustained bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which
caused his death, then we will pay the Sum Insured. However, the person(s) to whom the Benefit is paid shall sign an undertaking
to refund
such sum(s) so paid, to the Company, if the Insured Person is subsequently found to be alive.
G. Ambulance Cost
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which necessitates the use of an ambulance, we will reimburse the actual
ground ambulance costs on a per event per Insured Person basis, incurred by the Insured Person up to maximum of $500 for transportation
(including the medical supplies used) to the Hospital.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
H. Mobility aid upon accidental total & permanent disablement
If an Insured Person who sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident and suffers total and permanent disability and needs to and can
operate:
(i)	a self-powered, climbing wheelchair; and/or
(ii)	his motor vehicle with the controls suitably adjusted; and/or
(iii) a lift, necessary ramps, railings and holds installed to his/her usual place of residence;
We will, upon receipt of relevant documents as required under clause 14 (including proof of need and total and permanent disability certified
by a Registered Medical Practitioner), pay up to $10,000 of the costs of such equipment and the installation thereof, whichever is lesser.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.

passage.text:
E. Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which results in a Simple Fracture or Other Fracture of the nature
mentioned in the table below, we will pay the relevant amount specified in the table:-
Simple Fracture or Other Fracture due to Accident
Compensation
Schedule
(% of Sum Insured)
Neck, Skull or Spine (Full Break)	100%
Hip	75%
Jaw, Pelvis, Leg, Ankle or Knee (Other Fracture)	50%
Cheekbone, Shoulder or Hairline Fracture of Skull or Spine	30%
Arm, Elbow, Wrist or Ribs (Other Fracture)	20%
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
F.	Disappearance
If an Insured Person:
(i)	disappears as a result of the sinking or wrecking of the ship, aeroplane or vehicle in which he was travelling at the time of the Accident; and
(ii)	his body is not found within l year from the date of his disappearance; and
(iii) there is sufficient evidence leading to the conclusion that the Insured Person sustained bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which
caused his death, then we will pay the Sum Insured. However, the person(s) to whom the Benefit is paid shall sign an undertaking
to refund
such sum(s) so paid, to the Company, if the Insured Person is subsequently found to be alive.
G. Ambulance Cost
If an Insured Person sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident, which necessitates the use of an ambulance, we will reimburse the actual
ground ambulance costs on a per event per Insured Person basis, incurred by the Insured Person up to maximum of $500 for transportation
(including the medical supplies used) to the Hospital.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
H. Mobility aid upon accidental total & permanent disablement
If an Insured Person who sustains bodily injury as a result of an Accident and suffers total and permanent disability and needs to and can
operate:
(i)	a self-powered, climbing wheelchair; and/or
(ii)	his motor vehicle with the controls suitably adjusted; and/or
(iii) a lift, necessary ramps, railings and holds installed to his/her usual place of residence;
We will, upon receipt of relevant documents as required under clause 14 (including proof of need and total and permanent disability certified
by a Registered Medical Practitioner), pay up to $10,000 of the costs of such equipment and the installation thereof, whichever is lesser.
This Benefit can only be claimed either under the Core Scheme or Voluntary Scheme.
